problem: With Blood Vial, simulator action ids are vial=0, maxHP=1, leave=2; native menu order is maxHP=0,vial=1,leave=2. Both have all three actions. The rank-based replay adapter sends the wrong choice for the first two. Without Blood Vial, native and legal-rank order match. Rules and source labels have not been shown invalid by this adapter error.
repair: One shared simulator-action ordering helper is used in both natural replay directions. With Blood Vial, native buttons maxHP/vial/leave map to simulator actions1/0/2; without it, accept/leave map to1/2. Unexpected menus fail rather than selecting a different action. Simulator action identities, engine and neural decisions are unchanged.

software_tests.scope: Four mapping contract tests and three preexisting native UI boundary controls.

controlled_original.compared: HP, max HP, gold, relics, potions, deck/selection multisets, rewards and six persistent RNG streams; these method fixtures do not establish natural deck order.

limits: Targeted transport repair and one fixed natural route; not full parity, losing-route parity or learned performance.
